description: This file defines the ImportStatement class which models a TypeScript import statement, including its components such as module specifier, default import, named imports, and namespace alias.

classes.name: ImportStatement
classes.description: Represents a TypeScript import statement, encapsulating the raw import line, module specifier, default import, named imports, and namespace alias.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the import statement, reconstructing the import syntax based on its components.
